latest_release.name: v0.22.1
latest_release.body:
> [!CAUTION]
> This is an urgent security release. **Update as soon as possible!**

This release updates the PHP version to 8.3.36 to fix two critical vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 ([GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w](https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w)) and CVE-2026-109619 ([GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp](https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp))

With this release, FrankenPHP is also updated to version 1.13

Please update solidtime and any other PHP applications you are running **immediately**. 
You can find more details about the vulnerabilities here:
https://www.php.net/index.php#2026-10-21-5
